[[File:Blissl-SWA.jpg|thumb|right|Yoda's blissl hanging around his neck]]
The '''blissl''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument that had three pipes made out of some form of wood or organic bamboo-type material. It had a column of attached rings on each side of the outside pipes where the rope/string was threaded through to form the necklace. These instruments were maintained with a [[blissl tuner]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] carried a blissl around his neck while on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].
